messages.content: The Bahia says its pool will be closed all four nights. They offered a $75 nightly credit or a penalty-free cancellation. Compare that with the nearby Catamaran room you found, including parking, and make sure three people are allowed.

The Bahia reservation is $1,903.44 including the prepaid parking package. Taking the $300 pool credit would reduce its effective cost to $1,603.44. The Catamaran two-queen room is $2,248.12 after taxes and its resort fee, and parking is $47 per night paid at the hotel, bringing four nights to $2,436.12. It permits up to four guests, so two adults and one 14-year-old are allowed.
So switching costs about $833 more? Does canceling Bahia return the parking too, or is any part stuck there?

Yes. The exact difference is $832.68. Bahia confirmed that the entire $475.86 deposit, including the parking portion collected so far, is refundable under the repair waiver. No separate parking charge would remain.
When would that refund land? And is the Catamaran rate refundable if something else changes before June 9?

Bahia says it will release the refund within two business days, with another three to seven business days possible for the card issuer to post it. The Catamaran rate can be canceled without charge through 4:00 p.m. Pacific on June 5; after that, the penalty is one night's room and tax, $512.03.
Please confirm the Catamaran room really has two queen beds, not one bed plus a sofa. Also, what is the deadline on Bahia's waiver?

Confirmed: it is a standard room with two queen beds, and the occupancy record accepts all three guests. Bahia's special cancellation waiver expires at 6:00 p.m. Pacific tomorrow, May 27. The $75-per-night credit remains available if you keep the stay.
Switch it. A working pool is worth the extra cost for these four coastal nights. Cancel Bahia under the waiver and reserve the Catamaran, but leave the waterfront hotel and car exactly as they are.

Done. Bahia reservation BA-SD-61842 is canceled under the pool-repair waiver; $475.86 will return to the original card, expected in five to nine business days. The Catamaran two-queen room is reserved June 9-13 for three guests under CAT-SD-77104. The room total is $2,248.12, with $188 parking payable onsite, for $2,436.12 overall. The InterContinental stay, flights, rental car, and zoo plans are unchanged. The working trip total is now $6,848.30, with the checked bag, fuel, rides, zoo admission, meals, and Catamaran parking still estimated or payable later.
